record.title: ROBOTIS DYNAMIXEL XL330-M288-T - 18 g smart servo, 288.4:1, TTL multidrop bus, Protocol 2.0
record.origin_why: Every electrical, register, connector and dimensional figure in this folder was read off ROBOTIS's own pages and files, fetched 2026-09-02 and hashed in PROVENANCE.json: the e-Manual product page (E1), its docs.robotis.com successor (E2), the 'XL,XC-330.pdf' drawing (D1), the moment-of-inertia sheet (D2) and the vendor STEP body (S1). No published standard defines this actuator, so `standard` is wrong; nobody here has put an instrument on one, so `measured` is wrong. The GEOMETRY has a different origin and says so: cad/part.py was measured off Pollen's published mesh (see its docstring) and is graded against it in evidence/refcheck; the vendor's own STEP now sits in iterations/v0.0.1/geometry/ with its provenance.
record.lifecycle_why: No fetched vendor page states a lifecycle. The e-Manual banner says the manual site itself is being retired in favour of docs.robotis.com, which is about the documentation, not the part. robotis.us listed it InStock at $27.49 on 2026-09-02 (sourcing.json), which is availability, not lifecycle.
record.why: Manufacturer specifications are sourced; installed original servo identity and power topology remain unverified. Public HAT and pinned runtime conflict with the standard 3.7–6.0 V rating: retain the 15 SERVO_V failures and power-test holds. Runtime constants/comments are source evidence, not production measurements. Current interfaces exist, but reference-mesh anchors do not prove original mating geometry. The current simplified CAD has a 6 mm face pilot versus the vendor drawing 3 mm maximum; a separately verified correction candidate has not yet replaced the shelf iteration.

voltage_band_verdict.verdict: FAIL for the modeled standard XL330 supply compatibility; CANNOT DETERMINE installed original identity and actual production rail
voltage_band_verdict.source_observations: Pinned runtime reads Present Input Voltage(144), uses 6.6–8.2 V battery thresholds and writes Shutdown(63)=52, clearing bit 0. Public HAT connects motor power to +BATT. These are documented code/PCB facts, not measured production-unit behavior.
voltage_band_verdict.operational_disposition: Retain existing electrical test holds. Do not use robotd as a read-only identity tool: startup writes registers. Obtain offline identity evidence and establish the actual rail before powered acceptance tests.
remaining_unknowns: Original servo model, revision and any OEM specification
Original PCB revision and measured servo rail
Original screw schedule and physical seating
voltage_band_verdict.correction_why: Withdraw source comments as physical proof, unqualified extrapolated thermal/current claims, and unsupported powered-test/regulator prescriptions. A regulator would change recreation fidelity and does not resolve original identity.

mechanical_source_correction.status: CANNOT DETERMINE full fidelity; specific model discrepancies confirmed
